data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to manage and toggle the device torch or flashlight.
data.what_it_does: Provides a controller to natively check torch status, toggle flashlight on and off, and access native resources. It requires initialization before the app runs.
use_when: You need to build a flashlight utility app.
Your application requires turning the device's torch on or off programmatically.
avoid_when: You need camera preview or QR code scanning capabilities rather than just flash control.
strengths: Supports toggling lights and returning current state easily
data.setup_notes: Initialize TorchController by calling TorchController().initialize() before your runApp in main.dart.
